title: RRB Group D 27 Nov 2025 Shift 1 - Mathematics - Pipes and Cisterns
subject: Mathematics

questions.q: Three pipes, A, B and C, can fill a tank from empty to full in 40 minutes, 20 minutes and 30 minutes, respectively. When the tank is empty, all the three pipes are opened. A, B and C discharge chemical solutions P, Q and R, respectively. What is the proportion of solution Q in the liquid in the tank after 9 minutes?
questions.explain: The filling rates of pipes A, B, and C are $1/40$, $1/20$, and $1/30$ per minute, respectively. The total filling rate is $1/40 + 1/20 + 1/30 = (3 + 6 + 4) / 120 = 13 / 120$ per minute. The proportion of a specific solution in the tank corresponds to its pipe's fill rate divided by the total fill rate. The rate of B (providing solution Q) is $1/20$, which equals $6/120$. Proportion of Q = $(6 / 120) / (13 / 120) = \frac{6}{13}$. The time elapsed (9 minutes) does not affect the proportion.
